title: Circle meets rectangle
description:
Test whether a circle overlaps a rectangle.

```
circle (50, 50) r 10, rect (55, 40, 30, 20) -> hit
circle (10, 10) r 5,  rect (20, 20, 10, 10) -> no hit (corner distance 14.14)
```
hints: `float nx{std::clamp(cx, rect.x, rect.x + rect.w)};` and the same for y (lesson 3.01).
Hit when `dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r`; this is what `CheckCollisionCircleRec` does.
requirements: Find the point of the rectangle closest to the circle's centre with `std::clamp`.
Test the four sides and a corner.
